title: Law Firm Management System
overview: The Law Firm Management System (LFMS) is a web-based platform designed to centralize legal firm operations including case management, client interaction, document sharing, and automated billing. It provides role-based access for admins, lawyers, and clients to streamline workflows and reduce administrative workload. The system includes features such as real-time chat, calendar scheduling, and time logging.
